metadata.name: Dustwater
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A Wild West town on one dusty main street (Style Pack 02: Frontier Dust): the saloon with swinging doors, the bank and its vault (blow the dynamite by the door, or work the combination), the jail, the store, the chapel and livery. The train comes through past the station all match (it runs you over; ride the flatbed), and up the hill a mine cart trundles out of the tunnel. Dynamite to throw, crates that go up, plank barricades to blast through.

do.text: BOOM! The vault door is blown open!
The tumblers turn... the vault opens in ten seconds.
